conf.description: Facility SNMP APC/NMC event.txt tab-delimited event-log direct route: shares the row grammar and header-metadata-passthrough shape this corpus already built for the sibling ups-trap csv-file pipeline (same event.txt file), per recommendations.direct.cribl (no vendor pack/integration exists)

conf.comment: APC NMC event.txt fetched by an external scheduled FTP/SCP pull - the SAME file the sibling ups-trap csv-file pipeline parses (this dataset's own notes: 'shares the event-log file pipeline used on the ups-trap side'). ASSUMPTION carried over unchanged: each event line is tab-delimited Date\tTime\tEvent\tEventCode with Date as YYYY-MM-DD; header-block lines (version, retrieval time, card Name/Contact/Location/IP) do not match and pass through unparsed. Cribl-side scope is the row split and Event Code de-dup key only - per-event account-name/outcome extraction from the description text is named only in the Elastic-side recommendation (grown grok patterns), so it is NOT attempted here.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, row-grammar assumption (shared with ups-trap), and the Cribl-vs-Elastic scope split
split an assumed tab-delimited event row into Date/Time/Event/Event Code; header-block lines simply do not match and leave these fields undefined

computed fields read via bracket access before rename: the four-digit-year Date+Time compose into _time (never @timestamp, constraint 1) via Date.parse (concatenation must happen first, so auto_timestamp cannot be used directly); the space-named header-block fields ('card Name'/'card IP') would fail a path-based rename, so they are read here with __e[] bracket access
batch-rename the two clean-identifier staging fields our own regex produced

tag event.dataset (no hyphen, shared with the syslog/trap routes' data stream) and drop the two staging fields consumed into _time. The space-named 'card Name'/'card IP' originals are left in place as harmless duplicates - eval.remove rejects space-containing paths the same way it rejects hyphens
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
